- Acme: James Smith (product), Emily Tran (procurement)
- Redwood: Monica (CS lead), Lauren (solutions engineer), me (AE)

2) Please loop in the procurement contact who will handle DocuSign & PO questions — I see Emily on cc but confirm if we should include anyone else.
3) I attached a draft MAP and a capacity forecast for your review. If you can annotate expected % uplift by 05/19 we can lock hardware planning.

I’ll follow up internally with Monica and Lauren to ensure SRE and pricing are ready for the QBR.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.
